content.content:
5aa5d8146 fixed some compilations issues and added more type information
2c40357f4 Merge pull request #362 from Waldo1637/addGenerics
01ef7900e Full body printing of DominatorTree
70435f456 Make classes in soot.toolkits.graph generic
2b8eaab1f remove quotes from source file tags before writing them out to Jasmin, because Jasmin cannot handle them
82386fbd6 Fixes #360
97fbbd5c0 Fix: If a trap still covers the last unit of a body, we need an extra unreachable nop statement to define the trap. Remember that the end of a trap in Soot is defined using by the first statement that is no longer covered by the trap, so there is no natural end definition for a trap that still includes the very last unit in the body and we need an artificial unit as a stop marker. This marker is then however an empty block which we need to filter out when building block graphs.
a58f4f5be patched an issue with command parser of the CFG viewer
4bebc7496 new common base class for the fix for #339
4bca687c6 Fixed an issue with catch-all traps and monitors. Whenever a monitor is held at a certain position in the code and this position may throw an exception, one must make sure that there is a trap which exits the monitor before leaving the method.
86b0e6ef5 fixes an issue with a loop only being removed partially
4e93aaa47 cosmetic changes
a522c2938 made a method public, modernized the code, and removed a useless check
a3f45e648 added more fake edges for Android handlers
242a73f4b added some fake callgraph edges for android.os.Handler
9c995c385 Merge pull request #351 from MarcMil/feature-fixes

ff7b8bfa0 Fixes rare NPEs that can occur if an IResource has no file extension (i.e. getFileExtension returns null)
da918608e Updated Scene to use the .* to exclude pkgs
428502489 Fixed code tabs

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 70435f456d73b3ee2e555b8b4ec46df0b4411951

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation.** The fix commit `5aa5d8146` is titled "fixed some compilations issues and added more type information" and its diff is exclusively about adding/correcting generic type parameters (`HashMutableDirectedGraph<EquivalentValue>`, `DominatorNode<Node>`, `DominatorTree<Node>`, `MHGDominatorTree<Node>`, etc.) plus removing dead raw-type declarations. This is a classic "fixup commit" pattern, so I checked the immediate parent history: `git log` shows the direct lineage is
`70435f456 (Make classes in soot.toolkits.graph generic)` → `01ef7900e (Full body printing of DominatorTree)` → `2c40357f4 (Merge PR #362 addGenerics)` → `5aa5d8146 (this fix)`, all landing within the same 2–3 day window by two different authors (Waldo1637 then Steven Arzt).

**(2) Specific causative change.** `70435f456` converted `DominatorNode`, `DominatorTree`, `MHGDominatorTree`, and related `soot.toolkits.graph` classes from raw types to generics (e.g. `DominatorNode` → `DominatorNode<N>`, `getGode()` return type `Object` → `N`, `getChildren()` return type `List<DominatorNode>` → `List<DominatorNode<N>>`), and simultaneously touched dependent classes such as `ClassInfoFlowAnalysis.java` and `SimpleMethodInfoFlowAnalysis.java`, converting some of their iteration code without properly propagating the new generic type parameters everywhere. This left several call sites (`tests/soot/toolkits/graph/TestDominance.java`, `ClassInfoFlowAnalysis.java`, `InfoFlowAnalysis.java`, `CallLocalityContext.java`, `ClassLocalObjectsAnalysis.java`) using raw `DominatorNode`, `DominatorTree`, and `HashMutableDirectedGraph` types inconsistently with the now-generic APIs, producing the compilation problems that `5aa5d8146` subsequently fixes by adding the missing `<EquivalentValue>` / `<Node>` type arguments throughout.

**(3) Supporting evidence.**
- `01ef7900e` (the other commit merged in the same PR) only touches `CFGToDotGraph.java`, unrelated to any file fixed in `5aa5d8146`, so it can be ruled out.
- `git show 70435f456` confirms `DominatorNode`/`DominatorTree`/`MHGDominatorTree` were changed from non-generic to generic classes in exactly this commit, matching the type signatures that `5aa5d8146` retrofits in `TestDominance.java`.
- `HashMutableDirectedGraph<N>` / `MutableDirectedGraph<N>` / `DirectedGraph<N>` were already generic long before (confirmed via `git show 5aa5d8146~1:...` predates `70435f456`), so the newly-introduced inconsistency specifically comes from the `soot.toolkits.graph` genericization in `70435f456`, not a pre-existing raw-type issue.
- The fix commit's authorship (Steven Arzt, the project maintainer) immediately following the merge of Waldo1637's `addGenerics` PR strongly supports this being a same-day cleanup of build breakage introduced by that PR.

I'm confident `70435f456` is the bug/build-breaking commit; I could not find a materially different candidate since `01ef7900e` and the merge commit itself introduce no relevant code changes of their own.
